color-bg: Page background, and the 1px hairline between sliced sections (Divider, SettingList seams, border-bg).
color-surface: Cards, setting rows, table bodies and the hover fill of ghost buttons and button-shaped links.
color-surface-raised: Things that float: a menu, the unsaved bar, the hover on a secondary button, the new-lines pill. The secondary button's rest fill.
color-border: The unfilled part of a control: the unchecked Checkbox box, the Switch track off, the Progress track. Not a stroke around surfaces; cards, pills and alerts carry no border. 1.5:1 on bg, so it never carries meaning alone.
color-text: Body copy, labels and values on bg, surface, surface-raised and chip (8.99:1 or more on each).
color-text-dim: Descriptions and secondary copy (text-caption text-text-dim) on bg, surface and surface-raised (4.56:1 or more). On a mirage surface it lifts to #a6adb6.
color-text-mute: Tertiary labels: a DescriptionList term, a CopyField name, breadcrumb separators, a Badge label. Below 4.5:1 on bg (3.93:1), surface (3.58:1) and surface-raised (3.36:1), as the source sets it; keep it to short labels beside a stronger value. On a mirage surface it lifts to #949daa.
color-accent-blue: Links on bg and surface (9.89:1 on bg), and CodeBlock entities (attributes, properties, tags). Ayu Mirage blue.
color-accent-red: CodeBlock syntax red. The same hex as danger; use danger for state.
color-accent-cyan: Link hover (accent-blue shifts to accent-cyan, never an underline) and CodeBlock built-ins and types.
color-accent-yellow: CodeBlock functions and section titles. The same hex as warn; use warn for state.
color-accent-green: CodeBlock strings and additions. The same hex as success; use success for state.
color-accent: The one accent: the one primary action per view, the Tabs selection indicator, Progress fill, Spinner arc, the checked Checkbox and the focus ring (2px solid at 2px offset; 5.27:1 or more on every surface). As text, on bg, surface and surface-raised (5.27:1 or more).
color-accent-hover: The checked option text in a Select picker, on surface-raised (8.44:1). The same hex as accent-blue.
color-on-accent: Text and glyphs on an accent fill: the primary button label, the Checkbox tick. 4.45:1 on the primary button's resting fill (accent-fill, #357ac2 resolved) and 2.76:1 on its accent hover fill, as the source sets it.
color-accent-fill: The primary button's resting fill: accent mixed 72% into bg (color-mix in the source), so a full-bleed primary button sits quieter than the raw accent. Hover lifts it to accent. on-accent text on it is 4.45:1.
color-smoke: The Modal and Sheet backdrop, at 60% (color-mix of smoke into transparent): bg mixed 25% into black (color-mix in the source). Smoke says the page is blocked; light-dismiss popups take acrylic (.mirage-flyout) instead.
color-success: Done, the fix landed. As text on the surfaces, or a whole-surface /15 tint (bg-success/15). Never a border.
color-warn: Paused, a person must act. As text on the surfaces, or a whole-surface /15 tint (bg-warn/15).
color-danger: Failure. As text on the surfaces, or a whole-surface /15 tint (bg-danger/15); a field with an error fills bg-danger/15.
color-info: In progress, informational. As text on the surfaces, or a whole-surface /15 tint (bg-info/15).
color-chip: One step below bg: the fill of fields inside a setting row (bg-chip, no border) and of neutral chips.
spacing: The Tailwind spacing unit: every spacing utility is n x 4px, in device-independent px, not rem. Reach for the WinUI grid steps 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 24 / 32 (p-1, p-2, p-3, p-4, p-6, p-8); chrome bars are 48px, controls 32px (h-8) or 28px (h-7).
radius-control: Controls: buttons, inputs, selects, menu rows (rounded-control).
radius-panel: Surfaces and overlays: cards, menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts (rounded-panel).
shadow-flyout: Fluent 2 shadow16, for a flyout only (the Select picker, Menu, Popover): without it a panel on surface-raised bleeds into a table drawn on the same fill. Nothing else takes a shadow; depth is fill.
text-caption: Descriptions, metadata, group titles, labels in dense rows. 14px at the 18px root. The floor of a settings page; de-emphasised by colour (text-text-dim), never by shrinking.
text-caption-small: WinUI's small caption, for dense metadata only: version lines, timestamps. 12px at the 18px root.
text-body: Body copy, field values and setting labels. 16px at the 18px root.
text-body-strong: Emphasis inside body text, card titles and demo headings. 16px at 500.
text-body-large: Lead copy above body. 18px at the 18px root.
text-subtitle: Section and dialog headings (Modal title, Section). 20px at 600.
text-title: The page title, once per page. 28px at 600, -0.01em.
